note: AutoFix accepted R1-23 and R1-24 as 'queued' on 10-10, then went Critical-only, and they never landed. The test comment at RuntimeBrokerHttpServerTest.java:881 ('Every route that reads the execution store maps the same outage class the same way') is therefore not true yet. Only the HTTP server calls these two service methods, and the TS client (hosted-workspace-broker.ts) branches on 404/409/400/501, never on 500 vs 503. So this changes the wire contract and makes the comment true, without changing client behavior. Non-blocking.
